mechanism.rationale: Classical graph bounds and exact enumeration have mathematical justification distinct from prediction error. A midpoint of lower/upper bounds is not a certificate. Floating LP outputs should not be advertised as formal exact proofs without verified certificates.

significance.rationale: A strong benchmark-design correction: this endpoint discriminates neither powerful prediction nor theorem discovery; certificate validity must be evaluated separately.
